titleEn: Construct the Lexicographically Largest Valid Sequence
title: 构建字典序最大的可行序列
summary: 构造长度 2n-1 的序列：一出现一次，2..n 各出现两次且两个 i 的下标距离为 i，求字典序最大解。
insight: 从左到右填第一个空位，并按数字 n 到 1 尝试；第一个完整解必是字典序最大。数字大于一时同时检查并占用距离恰为其值的第二位置。
pitfalls: 大于一的第二位置必须未越界且为空
成功找到完整解后立即停止搜索

solutions.title: 降序回溯
solutions.idea: 用尝试顺序直接保证首个解的字典序最大。
steps: dfs 找最左空位；若无空位返回 true
value 从 n 降到一，未用且目标位置合法时放置，递归失败则恢复

code.java: class Solution { private int n;private int[] sequence;private boolean[] used;private boolean dfs(int index){while(index<sequence.length&&sequence[index]!=0)index++;if(index==sequence.length)return true;for(int value=n;value>=1;value--){if(used[value])continue;int second=value==1?index:index+value;if(second>=sequence.length||sequence[second]!=0)continue;sequence[index]=sequence[second]=value;used[value]=true;if(dfs(index+1))return true;used[value]=false;sequence[index]=sequence[second]=0;}return false;}public int[] constructDistancedSequence(int n){this.n=n;sequence=new int[2*n-1];used=new boolean[n+1];dfs(0);return sequence;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var n=0;private lateinit var sequence:IntArray;private lateinit var used:BooleanArray;private fun dfs(indexValue:Int):Boolean{var index=indexValue;while(index<sequence.size&&sequence[index]!=0)index++;if(index==sequence.size)return true;for(value in n downTo 1){if(used[value])continue;val second=if(value==1)index else index+value;if(second>=sequence.size||sequence[second]!=0)continue;sequence[index]=value;sequence[second]=value;used[value]=true;if(dfs(index+1))return true;used[value]=false;sequence[index]=0;sequence[second]=0};return false};fun constructDistancedSequence(n:Int):IntArray{this.n=n;sequence=IntArray(2*n-1);used=BooleanArray(n+1);dfs(0);return sequence} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int n;vector<int> sequence;vector<bool> used;bool dfs(int index){while(index<(int)sequence.size()&&sequence[index])++index;if(index==(int)sequence.size())return true;for(int value=n;value>=1;--value){if(used[value])continue;int second=value==1?index:index+value;if(second>=(int)sequence.size()||sequence[second])continue;sequence[index]=sequence[second]=value;used[value]=true;if(dfs(index+1))return true;used[value]=false;sequence[index]=sequence[second]=0;}return false;}public:vector<int> constructDistancedSequence(int input){n=input;sequence.assign(2*n-1,0);used.assign(n+1,false);dfs(0);return sequence;} };
